title: Test Automation Foundations: Unit, Integration & Flaky Tests in JavaScript
concept: Learn to write tests that catch real bugs and never cry wolf: the test pyramid, assertions and test doubles, testing async code with fake timers, finding flaky tests and measuring what a suite really covers.
description: Learn to write tests that catch real bugs and never cry wolf: the test pyramid and the trophy, assertions that explain failures, test data builders, stubs, spies and fakes, async code under fake timers, integration tests against an in-memory store, flaky tests, snapshot tests and coverage versus mutation score - all with Node 24's built-in test runner. 9 lessons, each starting from a real bug or incident, with beginner-friendly challenges.

lessons.title: What to test: the pyramid & the trophy
